verifications.note: Confirms the regulatory bid mechanics (tender BID/NGPL/11/2018/01/LBPL, cancelled per Public Notice BID/NGPL/11/2018/01/LBPL/02 dated 06.11.2019) but does not itself name Focus Energy as sponsor -- cited as corroboration of the project/cancellation facts, not of the Operator value.

fills.researcher_notes: This is the CANCELLED sibling of P1436's SGL/RJ-ON-6 field-evacuation cluster (three rival Langtala proposals, already adjudicated as distinct by the earlier cancelled review -- not re-litigated here). Sheet Owner is already 'Focus Energy [100.%]'; the flag is whether Operator should mirror it. indianpetroplus.com (200 OK, verified): 'Focus Energy submitted an EOI for a natural gas pipeline from Langtala, Rajasthan to Bhilwara, Rajasthan under Regulation 4(1) in April 2018... The pipeline is owned and operated by Focus Energy... enable evacuation of natural gas from RJ-ON/6 block Jaisalmer to the Hazira-Vijaypur-Jagdishpur pipeline of GAIL... in November 2019 PNGRB cancelled Focus Energy's bid to own and operate the pipeline due to the proposed tariff being excessively high.' PNGRB's own bid page (pngrb.gov.in/eng-web/ng-bid-11.html) independently confirms the project existed and was formally cancelled -- 'Tender Reference Number: BID/NGPL/11/2018/01/LBPL' with a 'Cancel- Public Notice No: BID/NGPL/11/2018/01/LBPL/02' dated 06.11.2019 -- matching indianpetroplus's account of the November 2019 cancellation, though the regulator's tender-tracker page does not itself print the sponsor's name (Reg 4(1) EOI-triggered bids are opened to any qualified bidder, so PNGRB's own page is sponsor-silent by design). Treating this as tier=medium: indianpetroplus is the only source directly naming Focus Energy as the would-be owner-operator; the PNGRB page corroborates the surrounding facts (existence, cancellation date, tariff-linked annulment) but not the Operator value itself. For a project that was cancelled before construction, 'Operator' records who would have run it, consistent with how Owner is already populated. Never cited gem.wiki or globalenergymonitor.org.
